messages.subject: WC-00167 Hollis — narrative for February bill
messages.plaintextBody:
James — drafting the bill narrative for the Hollis matter. I've recorded: advice note, three rounds of negotiation on the settlement agreement, the covenant variation and the execution. Total recorded time looks like ~31 hours, which lands at ~£21,400 — within Sarah's £18–26k estimate. OK to send to Accounts?

Elena
